platform.ownership_boundary: one host and one local filesystem authority
excluded_filesystems: filesystems without the required lock, sync, or atomic-rename semantics

lifecycle_policy.discovery: Resolve only the project-configured sidecar path and verify its SHA-256 digest before execution; PATH discovery is forbidden.
lifecycle_policy.start_or_connect: Connect only to the configured project socket and verified database identity, or start the verified sidecar when no exact healthy owner exists; never take over an unknown owner.
lifecycle_policy.health: Require protocol-v1 status and health responses bound to the expected socket, database identity, and process provenance before command admission.
lifecycle_policy.reconnect: Use bounded reconnect and read-based reconciliation for ambiguous durable responses; never repeat an authority mutation under a new operation identity.
lifecycle_policy.shutdown: Gracefully stop only a process started and still owned by this Spec Kitty host; do not kill an externally owned or provenance-ambiguous process.
lifecycle_policy.orphan_recovery: Reconnect to an exact healthy orphan after digest, socket, database, lock, and process-provenance checks; otherwise fail closed and require an explicit operator recovery decision.

prior_gapdb_evidence.reason: The GapDB-native adapter passed, but M1 must rerun all fourteen scenarios through the real go-kitty3 external adapter and produce product replay, lifecycle, ambiguity, and zombie-workspace evidence.

human_adoption.scope: The exact source, sidecar, module, protocol, lifecycle, platform, and evidence tuple produced by M1; no later commit or rebuilt binary inherits the decision.

admission_rationale: The architecture is ratified, the dependency-free M1 falsification target is preserved, every mutable GapDB identity needed to begin is pinned, and the historical two-agent harness is source-bound. Admission authorizes only the proving slice and does not authorize production cutover or M2.
stop_rule: If M1 cannot preserve one valid authority and reproduce the canonical restored/playback digest through the two-agent zombie scenario, stop, retain the failure evidence, and do not admit M2.
